Source The makers behind the blockbuster Hanu-Man are gearing up to take audiences into another larger-than-life fantasy universe!
 Primeshow Entertainment, the production house behind the blockbuster ‘Hanu-Man’, is all set to unveil its next exciting venture, ‘Hanuman 2: The Rise of Vanaras’, starring Panja Vaisshnav Tej.
 The intriguing announcement poster offers a glimpse into the grand and mystical world of the film, featuring a striking visual of a man ascending through the clouds, surrounded by a powerful, divine presence. The visually captivating poster hints at an ambitious fantasy adventure, instantly building curiosity around the film.
 Written and Directed by Vi Anand, the film is produced by K Niranjan Reddy and Chaitanya Reddy. With Panja Vaisshnav Tej leading the project, the film promises to take audiences into an exciting new cinematic world.
 View this post on Instagram A post shared by PrimeShow Entertainment (@primeshowentertainment) 
 ‘Hanuman 2: The Rise of Vanaras’ will release in five languages – Telugu, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam and Kannada, taking its story to audiences across the country.
 The Producer of the film K Niranjan Reddy, shares, “We have always believed in the power of stories that come from our culture and imagination. After Hanu-Man, we wanted to embark on a journey that would allow us to explore another fascinating world of fantasy. ‘Hanuman 2: The Rise of Vanaras’ is a step towards that vision. With an exciting story, a grand cinematic canvas and Panja Vaisshnav Tej at the forefront, we are looking forward to bringing something truly special to audiences. This is just the beginning of another exciting chapter for us.”
 After the phenomenal success of ‘Hanu-Man’, expectations are naturally high as Primeshow Entertainment gears up to present another ambitious fantasy offering. With this announcement, the excitement around the production house's next big cinematic venture begins!
